skill.ability.gathering.description: Gain experience by collecting natural resources.
skill.ability.mining.description: Gain experience by mining blocks and ores.
skill.ability.combat.description: Gain experience by defeating hostile mobs.
skill.ability.farming.description: Gain experience by harvesting mature crops.
skill.ability.husbandry.description: Gain experience by breeding and caring for animals.
skill.ability.defense.description: Gain experience from damage that actually removes health.
skill.ability.building.description: Gain experience by placing building blocks.
skill.ability.agility.description: Gain experience by walking, sprinting, and swimming.
skill.ability.magic.description: Gain experience by enchanting and using magical items.
skill.ability.archery.description: Gain experience by defeating hostile mobs with ranged attacks.
ability.ability.associated_ore.descripti: Unenchanted pickaxes can produce related bonus ores.
ability.ability.gravel_panning.descripti: When gravel would drop flint, it has a 20% chance to replace it with an unlocked metal nugget.
ability.ability.rapid_thrust.description: Increases attack speed at the cost of attack damage; higher ranks improve the tradeoff.
ability.ability.survivor.description: Reduces damage received from undead creatures.
ability.ability.long_journey.description: Grants Speed I at extreme altitudes; higher ranks expand the active altitude range.
ability.ability.energetic.description: Grants Speed II and Jump Boost I while the sum of food and saturation is high enough.
ability.ability.ambush.description: Deals increased damage to mobs that have not acquired a combat target.
ability.ability.breakthrough.description: Deals bonus damage to nearly full-health targets and grants brief Speed after taking damage at low health.
ability.ability.weak_point.description: Builds flaw marks on hit; the threshold hit deals amplified damage, stuns the target, and consumes 1 food point.
ability.ability.counter_sniper.descripti: Taking real damage from beyond 8 blocks marks the attacker; your next damaging hit gains bonus damage and consumes the mark.
ability.ability.stealth.description: Become invisible after a period without sound, taking damage, or dealing damage; the next damaging hit is amplified and ends Stealth.
ability.ability.dodge.description: Hold Sprint and Back, then press Left or Right to dodge sideways and reduce incoming damage briefly.
ability.ability.charged_leap.description: Hold the Charged Leap key, then release to leap upward; an airborne hit damages and stuns nearby enemies and negates landing damage.
ability.ability.primer.description: Hold Use with a fire charge in the offhand; release after charging to launch a fireball with increased explosion damage.
ability.ability.dangerous_charge.descrip: Increases explosion damage from firework rockets fired by crossbows without affecting rockets used for elytra boosting.
ability.ability.exhaustion.description: Instant Damage arrows immediately settle and clear remaining Poison and Wither effects on non-undead targets.
ability.ability.harvest.description: Melee attacks with hoes deal bonus damage based on current food and saturation, at the cost of extra exhaustion.
ability.ability.frugality.description: Reduces hunger spent on natural healing and the additional hunger costs of Harvest and Weak Point.
ability.ability.survival_skills.descript: Checks once per second and removes harmful effects whose remaining duration is below the current rank threshold.
ability.ability.retaliatory_flame.descri: While in fire, soul fire, or lava, ignites nearby enemies; soul fire and lava also deal fire damage. Disabled by Fire Resistance.
